title: Grant
description: The read-edge conformance unit: {subject, scope[]} attached to a Vibe. Scope semantics are store-enforced, always — never client-honor-system. Grants are owner-set; delegation is not specified. Stores MUST deny grants whose subject namespace they do not understand.

subject.description: Opaque string with a namespace prefix: id:{rnet-id} (a user), client:{name} (a registered application), public (anyone), or {x-namespace}:{...} (extension subject types).

scope.description: read: fetch Vibe/objects/elements — never origins, which are owner-only. write:user: mutate user blocks only. write:objects: create authored objects. write:inferred: write inferred entries directly, under a subject-namespaced task key. push: invoke push. pull: invoke a pull on already-configured sources. Grants are set by the owner alone — no scope delegates the ability to grant.
